label: VERIFIED
extraction: SPOQ (Specialist Orchestrated Queuing) introduces three innovations: (1) wave-based topological dispatch computing parallel execution waves from task dependency graphs, (2) dual validation gates applying quality metrics before execution (planning validation) and after (code validation) to reduce rework cycles, (3) Human-as-an-Agent (HaaA) integration where human specialists participate in decomposition and can be consulted during execution. Uses three-tier agent hierarchy: Opus workers, Sonnet reviewers, Haiku investigators for cost-quality optimization. Wave dispatch approaches critical-path lower bound (ratio 1.03-1.11, speedup up to 14.3x). On 2-slot local backend: stable 1.4x speedup. Planning coverage improved from 93.0 to 99.75, cyclic plans eliminated, parallelism lifted from 31.0 to 75.25. Dual validation reduces defect escape rate by 83%. File-system representation of epics/tasks, journal-based tracking, skill framework with SKILL.md directories.
